about_item: 【Long-Lasting Battery Life】Our small battery fairy lights come with 3 pre-installed 180mAh high-capacity LR44 batteries, totaling 540mAh. Enjoy up a long time of constant lighting, perfect for decorating various items. No need to buy extra batteries like with other brands, saving you time and money. Illuminate your mason jar, vase, crafts, parties, and more with ease(Actual battery life may vary depending on usage)

【3 Lighting Modes & Brilliant Glow】Experience the magic with our fairy lights that offer 3 lighting modes - Fast Flashing, Slow Blinking, and Constant Lighting. Each mode creates a beautiful firefly effect, perfect for any occasion. Effortlessly switch between modes using the mini push switch located conveniently on the side. The compact battery box (Small Size: 1×0.6×0.4 inches) ensures discreet placement, allowing your display to shine brightly without distractions

【7ft Bendable Silver Wire】Our bulk twinkle fairy lights are crafted with a flexible silver wire that can be easily bent into any desired shape. Wrap them around photos, shelves, walls, centerpieces,mirrors, crafts, wreaths, trees, branches, plants, flowers, or use them for wedding decorations. Let your creativity shine with these versatile and enchanting light

【Safe to Touch & Waterproof】Our mini string lights prioritize safety and durability. The silver plated copper wire is designed with a high-quality 1.5V low voltage insulated line, ensuring it remains cool to touch and safe for use. Additionally, our lights are IP65 waterproof, making them suitable for humid environments and even submersible in water (excluding the battery box). Enjoy worry-free illumination wherever you need it

【Versatile and Portable】Our decor fairy lights are perfect for a wide range of decorative uses. From weddings and parties to mason jars and crafts, they are pretty & vibrant that can transform any space. Use them in bedrooms, living rooms, nurseries, or even outdoors on patios, porches, and balconies. These micro blinking lights can be taken anywhere you want to add a touch of magic. They also make a lovely gift for friends or family looking to spruce up their surroundings

summary.text: Customers find these string lights easy to set up and turn on, and appreciate their versatility for decorating small craft projects. The appearance receives positive feedback, with one customer noting they create an instant glamor and romantic atmosphere. However, the durability is concerning as they only last one day, and the battery life is poor with batteries burning up fast. Moreover, the color and brightness receive mixed reviews, with some finding them perfect while others note they're not true warm in color. Additionally, customers report that the lights get dim very quickly.
